name: Vafthrudnir
summary: A C++ companion that reads your own files and measures how each one sounds — rhythm, key, spectrum, structure, dynamics — then hands the coordinates back to the deck. Pure DSP and no machine learning anywhere in it, so it runs on the kind of hardware Tapedeck itself runs on. This is what replaces the Every Noise placeholder behind the Genre Map and Playlist Lab. There is an architecture and there is no code: the repository is empty and nothing is installable yet.
adds: Per-recording sound coordinates instead of per-artist ones — and an AcoustID fingerprint for the 57% of a history that carries no recording MBID
